title: nunnarivu/wp-<issue>/evidence.json
description: The evidence a work package carries on its branch (KR-04): which files are its tests, which files are the change they prove, and the evidence type a checker in nunnarivu.yml verifies. Unknown keys fail.

type.description: An evidence type declared under evidence: in nunnarivu.yml, e.g. test-before-after.

tests.description: The package's test files, relative to the repository root.

implementation.description: The non-test files the package changed, relative to the repository root.

notes.description: What the tests prove, in the prover's words.
